## Appearance

Marilla is a tall, thin, and gaunt woman with sharp angles and no curves, whose appearance eventually comes to look old, worn, and tired. Her dark hair, which shows gray streaks that grow more prominent over time, is tightly twisted into a hard little knot in the back and secured aggressively with two wire hairpins. Though described as a dark, homely little thing as a child, her face later takes on a much softer expression.

## Personality

A woman of narrow experience, Marilla possesses a rigid conscience and a strict, critical disposition. She is characterized as sober, self-contained, sensible, and stoic, disdaining romantic sentiments or unseemly displays of deep emotion. Known for being calm, determined, and occasionally sarcastic after moments of self-betrayal, she conceives it as her duty to drill [Anne](../character/anne.md) into a tranquil uniformity of disposition. Despite her stern nature and tendency to worry about [Anne](../character/anne.md), she secretly hopes that [Anne](../character/anne.md) and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) will become a match. Her skills include crafting braided mats and making celebrated three-year-old homemade currant wine. Additionally, she detests cats and is prone to experiencing headaches.

## History

Marilla Cuthbert was raised in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), having moved into the new house at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) when she was already grown up. In her youth, she quarreled with John Blythe and refused his request for forgiveness, a decision that led to their permanent estrangement and a lifetime of hidden regrets. When her brother [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) accidentally brought home an orphan girl named [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) instead of the boy they had requested, Marilla initially planned to return her, but she ultimately relented after learning of Anne's neglected childhood and agreeing to raise her. Over the following years, Marilla navigated the challenges of raising the imaginative girl, enduring public embarrassments like Anne's explosive outburst at Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) and accidental disasters such as a liniment-flavored cake. As their bond deepened, Marilla suffered intense panic and realized how deeply she loved [Anne](../character/anne.md) after the girl broke her ankle, and she later stood by her when [Anne](../character/anne.md) mistakenly dyed her hair green. Following Matthew's sudden death from shock, Marilla learned that her own failing eyesight would prevent her from managing [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) alone, but she was saved from selling the farm when [Anne](../character/anne.md) gave up her college scholarship to remain at home. After the death of her cousin Mary Keith, Marilla took in two orphaned twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md), whose rowdy behavior presented fresh household trials. To ensure that [Anne](../character/anne.md) could attend [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college), Marilla invited the recently widowed [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to move into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and share the home. Through all of Anne's years away at school and subsequent return home, Marilla remained a steady anchor, managing the household alongside Mrs. [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) while watching [Anne](../character/anne.md) mature into adulthood.

## Quotes

> "Well now, yes. It always kind of gives me a thrill to see them ugly white grubs that spade up in the cucumber beds. I hate the look of them."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P58](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0058)

> "It’s five miles; and as you’re evidently bent on talking you might as well talk to some purpose by telling me what you know about yourself."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P8](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0008)

> "No, I don’t want any of your imaginings. Just you stick to bald facts. Begin at the beginning. Where were you born and how old are you?"
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER V. Anne’s History P10](../source/v01-c05.md#nw-v01-c05-p0010)

> "We’re not talking about poetry, Anne—we are talking about saying your prayers. Don’t you know it’s a terrible wicked thing not to say your prayers every night? I’m afraid you are a very bad little girl."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER VII. Anne Says Her Prayers P11](../source/v01-c07.md#nw-v01-c07-p0011)

> "Well, you’ll have to do without your thrill. I hadn’t any material to waste on puffed sleeves. I think they are ridiculous-looking things anyhow. I prefer the plain, sensible ones."
>
> — Marilla Cuthbert — [v1 CHAPTER XI. Anne’s Impressions of Sunday-school P10](../source/v01-c11.md#nw-v01-c11-p0010)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla initially brought [Anne](../character/anne.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by mistake, expecting an orphan boy, but ultimately decided to keep her out of pity and a sense of duty. Over time, Marilla transitioned from a strict guardian instructing [Anne](../character/anne.md) on household chores, prayers, and proper behavior into her affectionate adoptive mother. Though Marilla frequently orders [Anne](../character/anne.md) to her room or disciplines her for dramatic outbursts and missteps, she deeply cares for the girl and works closely with [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) to ensure she is properly raised and educated.

- Commands — guardian ordering her to her room  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER IX. Mrs. Rachel Lynde Is Properly Horrified P22](../source/v01-c09.md#nw-v01-c09-p0022), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P35](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0035)</sub>
- Mentor of — teaching her to cook  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P27](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0027)</sub>
- Parent of — adoptive mother (since v2)  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P81](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0081), [v3 ch.Dawn P9](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0009)</sub>

### [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/lynde--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/lynde.md) are close neighbors who frequently visit each other to discuss local affairs, school events, and domestic challenges. While Marilla occasionally finds herself mediating conflicts between [Rachel](../character/rachel-lynde.md) and [Anne](../character/anne.md), she trusts Rachel's advice on practical matters, including child-rearing. The two maintain a steadfast, supportive friendship through community events and times of personal difficulty.

- Friend of — neighbors and close acquaintances who comfort and help each other in tragedy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. ### [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/marilla-cuthbert--matthew-cuthbert.md)

Marilla and [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) were brother and sister who lived together at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and jointly managed the household and farm. Although [Matthew](../character/matthew.md) was quiet and far more inclined to indulge Anne's enthusiasm while Marilla handled discipline and practical raising, they consulted closely on all major decisions regarding their home. They shared a quiet, deep bond until Matthew's death.

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla serves as the legal guardian of her late cousin's orphaned twin son, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), taking him into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) out of a sense of duty. She actively manages his care and attempts to discipline his wild, mischievous antics, such as putting a toad in her bed or locking his sister in a toolhouse. Despite the frustration his lies and misbehavior cause her, Marilla grows fond of him and often laughs over his eccentricities behind closed doors.

- Commands — guardian who gives orders and disciplines him (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla took in [Dora](../character/dora.md) alongside her twin brother [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) after the death of their mother, assuming the role of her primary caregiver and guardian at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Marilla works to provide for her and protect her from her brother's mischievous pranks, managing the household as the children settle into a long-term stay.

- Comrade of — traveling companion to town (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--marilla-cuthbert.md)

Marilla took in [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) despite her initial expectation of a boy, gradually coming to love her like her own daughter. Though Marilla maintains a practical, stern exterior by assigning chores, sewing plain dresses, and reprimanding [Anne](../character/anne.md) for her wild imagination, she holds a deep affection for the girl and dedicates herself to her upbringing.
